uvarovite: A rare chromium-bearing garnet mineral with a vivid emerald-green colour.
uvea: The middle of the three concentric layers that make up the eye; it is pigmented and vascular, and comprises the choroid, the ciliary body, and the iris.
uveal: Of or pertaining to the uvea
uveous: Of, pertaining to, or resembling a grape or grapes.
uvula: Ellipsis of palatine uvula, the fleshy appendage that hangs from the back of the soft palate, that closes the nasopharynx during swallowing.
uvular: Of or relating to the uvula.
